data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'ahlag', meaning 'to be soft, gentle, and graceful'. In Islamic tradition, Mahlagha symbolizes the delicate nature of creation and the beauty of the universe. The name Mahlagha carries the meaning “Graceful, Delicate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahlagha usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
